newsitem.title: LATVIA: FORECAST - LATVIAN SAVINGS BANK PRICE SEEN AT 35-39 LATS.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - LATVIAN SAVINGS BANK PRICE SEEN AT 35-39 LATS.

text.p: The public offer price of Latvia's Savings Bank (Krajbanka) is expected to be between 35 to 39 lats after an auction for vouchers on June 2, securities dealers of the top nine banks said on Friday.

"Some 9,721 purchase orders have been registered by Savings Bank and the Mortgage and Land bank, applying for the one million shares," Aldis Sipols, securities department head at Savings Bank, told Reuters.
"I expect the auction result to be between 36 to 37 lats of vouchers," he added.
Pareks Bank dealer Leonid Ruderman saw the price at slightly below 40 lats.
Saules and Rigas komercbanka said they expected the price to be close to offers which have been made so far, around 35 lats.
The auction is similar to bourse trading, with the privatisation agency acting as the seller. The final price is arrived at by taking an average of all the offers.
Savings Bank share capital is currently 4.57 million lats with 52 percent in state hands and 25 percent held by individuals and legal entities.
"We might end up having more than 8,000 shareholders," Sipols said.
The final price will be set by the privatisation agency when it receives all the vouchers transferred to its account.
"It usually takes some three weeks for the agency to come up with the official price," Sipols said.
